materialHierarchy.application: opaque or raised application surface; content-first
materialHierarchy.systemOverlay: Regular Glaze when spatial context helps; opaque fallback required
materialHierarchy.systemPanel: Thick Glaze with restrained internal grouping; opaque fallback required
materialHierarchy.criticalSystem: Solid Glaze or highly opaque Thick Glaze with explicit security language

responsive.mobile: application content + system status + contextual bars + reachable dock where appropriate + system sheets
responsive.tablet: workspace + rail/applications + split or floating windows + contextual inspectors + Glaze system overlays
responsive.desktop: workspace + windows + optional widgets + restrained system bar + dock + contextual capsules + summoned system panels

fallbacks.reducedMotion: replace large spatial motion, morphing, launcher expansion, and depth movement with short crossfade, opacity, and small-scale feedback while preserving direct manipulation
fallbacks.reducedTransparency: replace Thin, Regular, and Thick Glaze with increasingly opaque surfaces while retaining hierarchy through borders, elevation, and tonal separation
fallbacks.highContrast: strengthen focus rings, window edges, selected indicators, panel opacity, status icons, and semantic boundaries while reducing atmospheric tint
fallbacks.deepDark: use Canvas #05070A, Base #0D1015, Raised #171C23 and tune routine highlights below maximum display luminance
